fusions.name: Rake from the Glide
fusions.desc: Glides up to 7 tiles onto an enemy and rakes it for 12 damage, stripping 10% of its armour for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +40%).

fusions.name: Stooping Drop
fusions.desc: Strikes the ground where you stand, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Feathered Twist
fusions.desc: Hops 2 tiles in the direction you face and increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Updraft Instinct
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 20% critical chance. Once every 8 seconds.
